title: sdks: unify auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across python/ts/go and bump to v1.27.0
author: Elena Gomez
description:
Motivation: bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to feature parity for auth, retry semantics, and streaming ergonomics; simplify developer ergonomics for common patterns and prepare for v1.27.0 release. Changes consolidate auth handling behind a single Credentials abstraction (supports API key, token exchange, and environment-based KMS flows), unify retry/backoff defaults and hooks across languages, and stabilize streaming APIs (consistent chunking, backpressure hooks, typed callbacks).

This PR is intentionally cross-repo (monorepo packages) but packaged as a single logical change to keep behavior consistent across SDKs. Work items: ENG-4521 (retry policy parity), ENG-4560 (streaming ergonomics).

Checklist:
- [x] Python: Credentials abstraction, retries, streaming iter/async iterator parity
- [x] TypeScript: auth provider interface, retry middleware, readable-stream helper + examples
- [x] Go: Client option chaining for auth/retry, streaming channel ergonomics, context cancellation tests
- [x] Tests: unit + integration + streaming e2e with local canary
- [x] Docs: README snippets and migration notes

Notes: Kept backward-compatible default behavior where possible; provided deprecation warnings for older init patterns. Migration guide included in release notes.
commits: feat(sdks): add Credentials abstraction and migrate python/ts/go; chore: bump versions to v1.27.0; fix(tests): stabilize streaming e2e; docs: add migration guide and examples

release_notes:
v1.27.0: Unified SDK auth/retries/streaming ergonomics across Python/TypeScript/Go.
- Credentials abstraction with env/KMS/OIDC support (all SDKs)
- Consistent retry/backoff defaults and hooks; pluggable middleware
- Stable streaming helpers: async iterator (Python), ReadableStream adapter (TS), channel-based client stream (Go)
- Migration notes added in docs/sdk-migration-v1.27.md
- No breaking changes to default behavior; deprecated old init signatures with warnings.
